title_zh: 凌晨三點的第七台洗衣機
title_en: The Seventh Washing Machine at 3 A.M.
story_zh: 凌晨三點，我走進二十四小時自助洗衣店。店裡明明只有六台機器，最深處卻傳來第七台滾筒轉動的聲音。 燈管閃了一下，牆角突然多出一台標著「7」的洗衣機。插頭躺在地上，滾筒卻轉得飛快，裡面有件熟悉的米色外套。 我正穿著一模一樣的外套。我伸手摸口袋，卻摸到一張陌生的取衣單，上頭寫著我的名字，取件時間是凌晨三點零七分。 我想離開，店門卻鎖住了。玻璃倒影裡，七台洗衣機都在運轉；回頭看，眼前仍只有第七台。倒影中的我站著不動。 第七台洗衣機突然停下。門上的圓形玻璃浮出另一張我的臉。她渾身濕透，雙手貼在玻璃內側，嘴唇一開一合：「不要開門。」 我往後退，手機卻響了。畫面顯示一則剛收到的通知：「您有一件衣物已完成清洗。」寄件者是我的電話號碼。機器內的我開始敲玻璃。 時鐘跳到三點零七分。洗衣機的門自己打開，裡頭沒有女人，只有一件摺好的米色外套。原本穿在我身上的那件，同時消失了。 我抓起取衣單，背面多了一行小字：「第七台只洗人，不洗衣服。」鏡子裡的我仍站在原地，但這次，她正穿著我的外套，而我沒有倒影。
story_en: At three in the morning, I entered the laundromat. There were only six machines along the wall, but I could hear a seventh drum spinning in the darkness. The lights flickered. A machine marked SEVEN stood in the corner. Its power cord lay unplugged on the floor, yet the drum kept turning. A beige coat tumbled inside. It looked like mine. I was wearing the same coat. When I reached into my pocket, I found a pickup slip I had never seen. It carried my full name. The collection time was three oh seven, just minutes away. I tried the door. Locked. In its reflection, all seven washing machines were spinning. But behind me, only the seventh was running. My reflection had stopped moving, even though I hadn't. The seventh drum stopped. My own face appeared behind its round window. She was soaked, pressing both palms against the glass. Her lips formed three words: DON'T OPEN IT. I backed away. My phone buzzed: ONE ITEM HAS FINISHED WASHING. The sender was my own phone number. The woman inside knocked three times, slowly, as if counting down. At exactly three oh seven, the door swung open. The woman was gone. Inside sat a neatly folded beige coat. The coat I had been wearing vanished from my shoulders at the same instant. I turned over the pickup slip. A new line had appeared: MACHINE SEVEN WASHES PEOPLE, NOT CLOTHES. In the glass, my reflection was still there, wearing my coat. But I no longer had a reflection of my own.
